identity_note: `prompt_fingerprint` was corrected offline. `arena75.identity()` calls `prompt.prompt_fingerprint()`, which hashes the module CONSTANT -- and the arm patches `system_prompt`, not the constant. So this block recorded the COMMITTED prompt's fingerprint beside the ARM's character count: two fields of one identity describing two different texts. The value now here is the fingerprint of the text that was actually sent, and it equals `arm_fingerprint`, which was always recorded correctly and is what the adoption was verified against. `prompt_version` is left as recorded: an arm has no version of its own and that field names the version it was patched over. No model was re-called and no attempt was changed. `arena75d.patched()` now patches `prompt_fingerprint` too, so a future arm records one consistent identity.
